summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing for Eayadati (عيادتي). Backend: 15/15 new iteration-2 tests pass (invoice PATCH/DELETE with RBAC, public PDF upload+serve without auth, public clinic info/slots/book with 409 double-booking + patient-by-phone reuse, patient doctor_notes persistence) AND 37/37 iteration-1 regression tests still pass = 52/52 total. Frontend (mobile 390x844, Expo web, RTL Arabic): (1) Public booking portal /book/{tenant_id} loads WITHOUT auth, shows 14 day chips + 16 slots (09:00-16:30), submits an end-to-end booking successfully and shows the success screen; unknown tenant correctly renders 'العيادة غير موجودة'. (2) Unified patient page renders all 5 sections (المعلومات الشخصية, ملاحظات الطبيب editable, مخطط الأسنان FDI, الأشعة, الفواتير) with PDF and WhatsApp buttons on patient invoices. (3) Invoices tab has 4 cards with PDF + واتساب buttons on the 2 patient invoices (correctly hidden on salary/expense/purchase kinds) and a kebab menu (edit/delete visible for doctor). (4) Inventory list has kebab menus on each item for edit/delete. (5) Settings screen renders map + GPS button (use-gps-btn) + booking link (correct URL) + share and preview buttons (doctor only). RTL/Arabic layout is clean. Only pre-existing RN-Web console warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) remain — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web deprecation: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Applied via shadow.card used in book/settings/patient screens.
RN-Web deprecation: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Migrate `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` in src/theme (shadow.card) to silence RN-Web deprecation warning across screens.
(Nice-to-have) server.py is 918 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, patients, invoices, storage, public, reports) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from 792 → 918 lines this iteration. Now clearly beyond the 700-line split threshold — plan a modular refactor.

public_book uses regex on the `date` field (`^{date}T{time}`) for double-booking detection which is correct given ISO string storage, but consider a compound index on (tenant_id, date, status) for scale.

public_book creates a patient with `notes='طلب حجز عبر الموقع'` but if patient exists by phone, does NOT update the record — acceptable for now; note that the incoming full_name is ignored on reuse (verified).

PDF upload endpoint POST /uploads/pdf is authed and returns a public URL served by GET /public/file/{id} without auth — correct security model; content is stored in Emergent Object Storage under `eayadati/public/{tenant}/{file_id}.pdf`.
Public endpoints (/public/clinic/*, /public/file/*) confirmed to work with NO Authorization header — verified via requests with empty headers.
Storage `_storage_key` module-level cache still has no lock (carry-over from iter 1). Low risk on single worker.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seed intact. Tests create/cleanup TEST_* records inside fixtures. One test booking record `TEST_UI_E2E` remains in demo tenant from the UI E2E flow — safe to ignore or manually clean via delete_appointment.
